While enabled, the Bat Familiar will hunt and devour ordinary bats,
 sharing part of its meal with its owner.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Default:** Night Vision.
\
\
**Upgraded:** [Life-Steal](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@bat_lifesteal).
\
\
**Iesnium:** [Bat-Flight](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@bat_flight).

While enabled, the Beaver Familiar will chop down nearby trees
 when they grow from a sapling into a tree. It can only handle small trees.
\
\
**Upgrade Behaviour**
\
Gives free snacks when shift-right-clicked with an empty hand.
\
\
**Iesnium Behaviour**
\
While enabled, allows its owner to attack Creakings directly without needing to destroy the Creaking Heart.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Default:** [Beaver Harvest](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@beaver_harvest).

While enabled, the Beholder Familiar highlights nearby entities with a glow effect, and shoots laser rays at enemies.
\
 It **eats** (poor) **Shub Niggurath babies** to gain temporary damage and speed.
When captured in a Familiar Ring or any Infused Equipment it can still apply glow.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Iesnium:** [Herald of Aberrations](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@herald_aberrations).

While active, it provides additional defenses for its owner, granting different immunities depending on its level.
\
\
**Upgraded:** Blindness effect.
\
\
**Iesnium:** Darkness effect.

While enabled, whenever the player picks up stone or cobblestone, there is a chance
 (33%% by default, server config) for the Blacksmith Familiar to repair their equipment a little bit.
\
\
**Upgrade Behaviour**:
\
Slowly repairs **one** equipment in the owner's inventory (each ~6 seconds, server config).
\
\
**Iesnium Behaviour**:
\
Slowly repairs **all** equipment in the owner's inventory (each ~6 seconds, server config).

After upgrading a Blacksmith Familiar, you can give him an [Iesnium Anvil](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/crafting_rituals/craft_iesnium_anvil),
 allowing him to perform advanced upgrades on other **upgraded** familiars.
\
\
References to Iesnium familiars refer to this final upgrade.
When captured in a Familiar Ring or any Infused Equipment it can still repair the user's equipment.

The Iesnium Upgrade works like a regular upgrade, but consumes Iesnium instead of iron.
 (requires 32 ingots by default, server config).
\
Other differences include the name star appearing as **prefix** of the name
 and a higher stats bonus (+9 extra damage and +50 max health).

When the blacksmith upgrades a familiar, a message appears in the chat,
 an anvil sound is emitted, and a star appears as **suffix** of the familiars name.
\
Upgraded familiars has better stats (+3 damage bonus and +20 max health)
 and provide additional benefits described in their entries.

To upgrade familiars the blacksmith needs to be given iron ingots or blocks by [#](AA00AA)right-clicking[#]() it
 (requires 18 ingots by default, server config).
\
An iron ingot will appear on the blacksmith's anvil for each upgrade he has enough materials to perform.
\
Be patient after upgrading a familiar, as there is a cooldown before another one can be upgraded.

Whenever the Chimera attacks, an additional ability will be triggered.
Depending on the type of attack.
\
**Default:**
 - LION: set on fire.
 - SNAKE: apply poison.
 - GOAT: great knockback.
\
\
**Upgraded:** .
 - PAW: stun the enemy;
\
\
**Iesnium:**
\
Can apply two of the abilities listed above per hit.

When **upgraded** by a Blacksmith Familiar, the Goat Familiar will get a warning bell.
 When you hit the familiar it will ring the bell and attract enemies in a large radius.
When you feed the Chimera a [](item://minecraft:golden_apple), the [#](ad03fc)Goat[#]() will detach and become a separate familiar.

Give a [](item://minecraft:lapis_lazuli) to transform in a [](item://minecraft:prismarine_shard), the efficiency of this conversion depends on Cthulhu's level.
\
\
**Upgrade Behaviour**
\
 When upgraded by a Blacksmith Familiar, it will act as a mobile light source.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Default:** Water Breathing.
\
\
**Upgraded:** Dolphin Grace.
\
\
**Iesnium:** Conduit Power and [Lord of the Aquatic Depths](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@aquatic_lord).

When upgraded by a Blacksmith Familiar, it will attack nearby enemies with a hammer.
\
 Yep, a **hammer**.
\
\
If Deer Familiar has the Iesnium Upgrade, this attack will also inflict Wither
 and has a small chance to summon lightning.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Default:** Speed and [Step Height](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@step_height).

While active, it provides additional defenses for its owner, granting different immunities depending on its level.
\
\
**Upgraded:** Slowness effect.

While enabled, the Devil Familiar attacks and burns nearby enemies.
\
\
When upgraded by a Blacksmith Familiar, you can give a [](item://minecraft:golden_apple) or [](item://occultism:golden_pitaya) to obtain the enchanted version.
\
**Warning:** This conversion has a five-minute cooldown if the Devil does not have the Iesnium Upgrade.
When captured in a Familiar Ring or any Infused Equipment it can still setting enemies on fire.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Default:** Fire Resistance.
\
\
**Iesnium:** [Emperor of the Nether](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@nether_emperor).

The Dragon Familiar will collect sticks from the ground and bring them to you.
\
\
Greedy familiars can ride on dragon familiars, combining their powers.
\
\
When upgraded by a Blacksmith Familiar, it will throw swords at nearby enemies.
When captured in a Familiar Ring or any Infused Equipment it will continue throwing swords at nearby monsters.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Default:** [Dragon's Greed](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@dragon_greed).
\
\
**Iesnium:** Hero of the Village.
\
\
You can give it [](item://minecraft:gold_nugget) to increase its effects max level for 5 minutes.

While active, it provides additional defenses for its owner, granting different immunities depending on its level.
\
\
**Iesnium:** Bad/Raid/Trial Omen effects.

By default, you cannot use Multi Jump while gliding with an [](item://minecraft:elytra),
 but this restriction can be overcome by having a Drikiwing Familiar with the Iesnium Upgrade.

[#](AA00AA)Drikwings[#]() are a subclass of [#](AA00AA)Djinni[#]() that are known to be amicable towards humans.
 They usually take the shape of a dark blue and purple parrot.
 Drikwing Familiar will provide their owner with limited flight abilities when nearby.

To obtain the parrot for the sacrifice, consider summoning them using either the [Parrot Ritual](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/familiar_parrot).
\
\
**Hint:** If you use mods that protect pets from death, use a hopper to start the ritual!

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Default:** [Multi Jump](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@double_jump), Jump Boost and Slow Falling.

While active, it provides additional defenses for its owner, granting different immunities depending on its level.
\
\
**Upgraded:** Fall damage (and cancels Farmland Trample).

The Fairy familiar **keeps other familiars from dying** (with cooldown),
 helps out other familiars with **beneficial effects** as needed
 (speed, resistance, fire resistance, water breathing, slow falling).
\
\
The healing abilities allow the Fairy to turn [](item://minecraft:rotten_flesh) into [](item://minecraft:leather).
When upgraded by a Blacksmith Familiar, you can give a [](item://minecraft:glass_bottle) to transform in a [](item://minecraft:dragon_breath).

Whenever the Fairy attacks, the enemies life force is drained and transferred to nearby familiars.
an additional effect will be applied to the target. Possibilities depend on the familiar level.
\
**Default:**
 - Slowness
\
\
**Upgraded:**
 - Glowing
 - Levitation
\
\
**Iesnium:**
 - Poison
 - Wither
When captured in a Familiar Ring or any Infused Equipment it will heal other nearby familiars owned by the wearer.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Upgraded:** Regeneration.
\
\
**Iesnium:** [Fairy Blessing](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@fairy_bless).

The Greedy Familiar is a Foliot that will pick up nearby items for it's master.
 [#](AA00AA)Shift-right-click[#]() with empty hand to open a screen that can set a [Spirit Filter](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/summoning_rituals/transporter_filters).
\
\
When upgraded by a Blacksmith Familiar, it can find blocks for its master.
 [#](AA00AA)Right-click[#]() it with a block to tell it what to look for.
When captured in a Familiar Ring or any Infused Equipment it increased the pick-up range of the wearer.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Upgraded:** [Greedy Harvest](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@greedy_harvest).

While active, it provides additional defenses for its owner, granting different immunities depending on its level.
\
\
**Iesnium:** Mining Fatigue effect.

The guardian familiar sacrifices a limb everytime it's master
 is about to die and thus **prevents the death**.
 Once the guardian dies, the player is no longer protected.
\
\
When summoned, the guardian spawns with a **random amount of limbs**,
 there is no guarantee that a complete guardian is summoned.
\
\
Regains one limb for each Blacksmith Familiar upgrade it receives.

When captured in a Familiar Ring or any Infused Equipment
 the death protection no longer costs limbs. Instead, the
 wearer receives a cooldown effect whose duration varies
 depending on the number of limbs and the Guardian's Familiar level.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Upgraded:** Health Boost (level is equal to the number of limbs).
\
\
**Iesnium:** Resistance (level is equal to half the number of limbs).

While enabled, The Headless Ratman Familiar steals the heads of nearby slain monsters.
 It then grants its master double damage against that type of creature.
\
When upgraded by a Blacksmith Familiar, it applies weakness to nearby mobs of the same type as the head it stole.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Upgraded:** [Pumpkin Head](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@pumpkin_head).
\
\
**Iesnium:** Strength.

While active, it provides additional defenses for its owner, granting different immunities depending on its level.
\
\
**Iesnium:** Weakness effect.
When captured in a Familiar Ring or any Infused Equipment it can still attack nearby enemies.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Default:** [Dodge](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@mummy_dodge).

Spawns small versions of itself to fight for you, if it isn't sitting.
The cooldown of this ability depends on the Shub Niggurath Familiar level.
\
\
**Default:** 10 seconds.
\
\
**Upgraded:** 5 seconds.
\
\
**Iesnium:** 1 second.

When **upgraded** by a Blacksmith Familiar, the Shub Niggurath Familiar will get a warning bell.
 When you hit the familiar it will ring the bell and attract enemies in a large radius.
\
\
 *If the goat used in the transformation already has a bell, it will be retained.*

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Iesnium:** [Whisperer of the Forest](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@forest_whisperer).

When an Iesnium Wingnis owner cheats death, whether through a [Guardian Familiar](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/familiar_guardian) abilities,
 a [](item://minecraft:totem_of_undying), or any similar methods, they will receive several benefits:
 Full Heal, Strength, Speed, Fire Resistance, Resistance, Regeneration, and Saturation.

Different effects can be applied depending on the familiar's level.
You can configure them using the [Familiar Tablet](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/tablet).
\
\
**Default:** [Multi Jump](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@double_jump), Jump Boost, Slow Falling and Glowing.
\
\
**Upgraded:** [Fire Wings](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/getting_started/effects@fire_wing).

While active, it provides additional defenses for its owner, granting different immunities depending on its level.
\
\
**Default:** Fall damage (also cancels Farmland Trample) and Levitation effect.

The [#](AA00AA)Wingnis[#]() is not summoned directly. First, summon a [Drikwing Familiar](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/familiar_rituals/familiar_drikwing), give it a [](item://minecraft:totem_of_undying) and bring it to a [#](AA00AA)Nether Biome[#](),
 then click the drikwing with [Flaming Paste](entry://occultism:dictionary_of_spirits/crafting_rituals/craft_flaming_paste). Make sure it dies to fire so you can obtain the [#](AA00AA)Wingnis Familiar[#]().

Occultists focused on necromancy who pioneered the study of resurrection rituals
 began with “incomplete” rituals, bringing undead versions of mounts back to life.

The following pages present different rituals, one for each type of undead mount.
\
\
**Note:** Unfortunately, the sacrifice’s attributes do not determine the power of its resurrected version.
Click to change book current category.

Change the effect being configured by clicking or scrolling the mouse wheel.
\
The bar's color indicates the familiar level required.
 The higher of the selected and available levels will be applied.
 - Gray -> Default
 - Green -> Upgraded
 - Blue -> Iesnium
 - Red indicates that it is disabled.

When using this device, you can enable or disable familiar abilities and set the level of the applied effects.
\
\
On servers, you need to click the confirm button to save your changes.
